_doc: red_dispatch.py's settings (item RIMMANDRAKE_ROUTE_NIGHTLY_REDS_RAISED_INTO_A_RETIRED_POOL). The build cop files one SELFTEST_FIX_* / NIGHTLY_COP_FIX_* item per red root cause; this step hands each one to ONE capped detached fixer, at most once a night and never a second automatic try (a failed attempt is a Needs Conductor line). The owner, 2026-11-14 ~9 PM PST: "As long as we don't have automated loops rejecting/cycling things, we can't get into too much trouble."
_max_live_doc: At most this many live detached runs on red-fix items at once, hand launches included.
_night_doc: A night runs from 03:00 Pacific (the nightly sweep's start, rm-selftests-nightly.timer) to the next 03:00.

opus_if._min_tests_doc: one first error line shared by this many tests is a cause in shared code, not in one test

_opus_if_doc: Sonnet is the default: the red selftest itself proves the fix. Opus when any opus_if rule matches (the cause is in complex code: C#, a build, a shared cause, a mod's own tree). Ladder: infrastructure/agents/Agent_Policy.md.
